name: Premier Explosives Ltd
title: Premier Explosives Ltd - 526247 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Record INR1,569 cr order book (4.04x FY26 revenue) but FY26 revenue fell 7% to INR388 cr on raw-material and plant-accident delays; FY27 guided INR600-700 cr, a 50-80% jump that depends on unproven alternate materials and Katepally commissioning.

capex.quote: the total capex for '26 and '27 was INR45 crores was required for Katepally expansion and INR15 crores for PDK

triggers.label: FY27 revenue INR600-700 cr vs FY26 388 cr
triggers.quote: yes, it is -- we are to be -- yes, targeting INR600 crores to INR700 crores.

triggers.quote: It may go up to Q3 because see, we are in the business of explosives

triggers.label: Order book 1,569 cr; 2/3 of 430 cr order by FY27 end

triggers.quote: It is not recurring. It is one -off nature.
